reason: I do the billing myself every month, so I already know where the free work goes, and most of it is deliberate because it keeps clients sweet. I might take the free audit if I had a quiet afternoon, but I'm not paying £240 a month for something to tell me what I chose not to bill.
objection: Most of what you'd flag as missed money is goodwill I chose to give, and chasing it risks the relationships that keep us going. I also don't want to hand over client contracts and PSA data to a new outfit for a report I can mostly guess myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit turned up real unbilled licences or forgotten billable time, not goodwill, worth well over the £2,880, with the tickets to prove it, I'd consider the monthly check.
